filename_assessment.finding: All designated original filenames already exactly match the catalog and helper input rule; no renamed staging copies were needed.

baseline_sha256_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines: physical-page<TAB>filename<TAB>page-sha256<LF>, in physical-page order

restoration.purpose: Recreate the ignored canonical cache without renaming, overwriting, re-rendering, or otherwise modifying originals.
procedure: Read project/T1/source-map.json and create project/T1/pages/T1 if absent.
For every pages row, copy original_file to project/T1/canonical_image with metadata-preserving copy2; source and destination names remain page-NNN.jpg.
After every copy, compute destination SHA-256 and require exact equality with that row's sha256.
Require the destination filename set to equal all 362 canonical_image basenames; reject missing or unexpected files.
restoration.python_script:
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import copy2
import hashlib, json
m = json.loads(Path('project/T1/source-map.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
expected = set()
for p in m['pages']:
    src = Path(p['original_file'])
    dst = Path('project/T1') / p['canonical_image']
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    copy2(src, dst)
    assert hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == p['sha256']
    expected.add(dst.name)
actual = {p.name for p in Path('project/T1/pages/T1').iterdir() if p.is_file()}
assert actual == expected
